event: Determine the location of the sounding object (creak and thud of a door closing) relative to a hypothetical robot standing by the fireplace and facing a specific armchair.

sounding_object.description: The main entrance door of the house. It is an arched wooden door, painted a light blue/grey on the exterior-facing side (visible when open) and dark brown on the interior-facing side. It has a black handle and a wreath on the exterior. Approximate size: standard door height (~2 meters), width ~0.8-1 meter.

reference_object.description: A white recessed fireplace with a dark wooden mantelpiece. Above the mantelpiece is a large, circular mirror with a decorative, colorful tiled border. The fireplace opening is arched. Decorations include small figurines and a string of carrot-shaped ornaments on the mantel.

facing_object.description: A light-gray upholstered armchair with a modern, boxy design. It has a loose back cushion and a blue decorative pillow with a white pattern. It is one of two similar armchairs placed near a large arched window. This specific armchair is the one positioned further from a small wall painting (located near a white interior door) and closer to the main entrance door.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the white recessed fireplace and facing the light-gray armchair further from the wall painting, when the creak and thud sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
